column5: Database routes plain, DISTINCT, ordered, and ordered-DISTINCT evaluation through the canonical state family; it preserves raw result bytes and encoded collation-key tuple boundaries. Plain update/merge/reset/NULL/byte truncation, unordered DISTINCT membership with deliberately unspecified output order, bounded ordered top-N worst-row eviction/row truncation/partial-separator behavior, ordered merge rejection, and same-architecture base spill bytes are ported. The live Database has no group_concat_max_len session variable, warning/error publication, or aggregate-shared sentinel across independently allocated group states; exact Go memory deltas, Datum comparator error propagation inside heap Less, native spill portability, helper-buffer capacity policy, and hash-aggregation spill orchestration remain explicit gaps.
